title: Mt Eliza Farmers Market
summary: The only VFMA-accredited farmers market on the Mornington Peninsula. Only genuine farmers and specialty makers. Monthly on the 4th Sunday. Produce includes Flinders Sourdough, Mumma Made jams, Red Hill Apples, Blue Bay cheese. VFMA accreditation guarantees farm-gate authenticity.
streetAddress: Corner Mt Eliza Way and Canadian Bay Road
accessibilityNotes: Village precinct; generally accessible; footpath stalls
nearbyAttractions: Mount Eliza Village cafes; Mt Eliza beach

heroImage.alt: Farmers market stalls on the Mornington Peninsula — Mt Eliza Farmers Market

editorVerdict: The only VFMA-accredited farmers market on the Peninsula: if the producer's name is on the stall, the producer grew it.
editorNote:
Mt Eliza runs the fourth Sunday of every month in the village precinct. The VFMA accreditation is the point: no resellers, no imports dressed up as local. Flinders Sourdough, Mumma Made, Red Hill Apples, Blue Bay cheese: a tight, quality lineup rather than 200 stalls of variable quality.

The move: go for the weekly shop, not the day out. Bring bags and an esky, hit it by 9:30am, then stay for brunch in the village. The right market if you care about provenance over volume.
